description: This file defines a deprecated profiling class 'profile' for legacy PyTorch autograd profiling, including methods for configuration, starting/stopping profiling, and exporting results. It also contains a function to parse legacy profiling records.

classes.name: profile
classes.description: A deprecated context manager class for legacy autograd profiling in PyTorch.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the profile object with profiling options.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Returns the profiling configuration based on current settings.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Enables the profiler context, raising error if reentrant.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Stops profiling, processes records, and stores function events.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: String representation of the profiler object.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: String form of the profiling results.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Returns a table of profiling results with sorting and display options.

methods.name: export_chrome_trace
methods.description: Exports profiling data in Chrome trace format.

methods.name: export_stacks
methods.description: Exports stack traces of profiling data.

methods.name: key_averages
methods.description: Returns key averages of profiling data.

methods.name: self_cpu_time_total
methods.description: Returns total CPU time across all events.
